D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Maxine Waters leads by 63.4 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 171,182 votes; a one point swing is about 1,350 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +57.9 and D +68.6. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$332K cash against $331. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
